title: hybrid.rs: MeshPrefix::contains() panics on prefix_len > 128 (variant)
description: Line 135: `full_bytes = (self.prefix_len / 8) as usize` can exceed 16 when prefix_len > 128. Line 139 then accesses `addr[..full_bytes]` on a 16-byte array, causing a panic. No validation bounds-checks prefix_len to 0-128 in MeshPrefix::new() or add_mesh_prefix().
